newsitems.title: Watch the Hades Orchestral Concert, Live from London!

newsitems.contents: On June 27 at London's Royal Festival Hall, our composer and audio director Darren Korb will be joined by his fellow Hades vocalists and conductor Austin Wintory in a one-time-only orchestral concert, Ballads of the Underworld!
